items.item_text: 01. Golden West College is committed to fostering a culture of inclusive excellence by uplifting employees and students through an environment that is equitable, diverse, inclusive, and accessible. When responding to the questions below, please provide clear examples with successful outcomes, offer instances where you applied job skills to enhance diversity, equity, and inclusion, as well as your input towards advancing the overall culture at your former workplace. Please confirm Yes to acknowledge that you have read and understand these guidelines. Options: Yes | No
02. This is a transfer recruitment open to current Coast Community College District employees who have expressed interest. Please list your employee ID and current position.

03. This position requires working knowledge of personal computer-based software programs, including but not limited to Microsoft office products, EPAFs, Banner and Argos. List all office or other software programs and/or applications in which you are proficient. For each one that you have listed, please describe your level of proficiency (beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert).

04. Please describe your level of skill and experience in implementing fiscal processes and procedures, including setting up and monitoring budgets, processing purchase orders, tracking expenditures, and handling contracts with vendors.

05. Provide a brief summary of your experience with interdisciplinary and/or cross-departmental faculty collaborations. Include the nature of the collaboration, your contributions, and the resulting outcomes or impact.

06. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current Resume (attachment) 3. A Cover Letter (attachment) 4. Answers to supplemental questions Options: Yes | No
